tools.name: docker_to_systemd
tools.description: Translate docker run CLI commands or docker-compose.yml files into hardened Linux systemd .service or Podman Quadlet .container units.

tools.name: systemd_security_audit
tools.description: Audit a Linux systemd .service unit against 10 kernel sandboxing controls and compute its security exposure score (0.1 to 10.0).

tools.name: seccomp_apparmor_generate
tools.description: Generate an OCI seccomp.json syscall allowlist and AppArmor MAC confinement profile from a systemd .service unit.

tools.name: server_log_analyze
tools.description: Analyze Nginx and Apache Combined access logs for HTTP status distribution, error rates, bandwidth, top IPs/endpoints, and suspicious traversal/injection requests.

tools.name: docker_run_to_compose
tools.description: Translate a docker run command into a clean docker-compose.yml service definition preserving ports, volumes, env vars, restart policy, and networks.

tools.name: dockerfile_lint
tools.description: Lint a Dockerfile against security and build-cache best practices (latest tags, root USER, apt cache cleanup, ADD vs COPY, HEALTHCHECK, exposed secrets).

tools.name: docker_image_manifest_inspect
tools.description: Inspect OCI / Docker image manifest.json or config JSON to report layer digests, total size, entrypoint, exposed ports, and env keys.

tools.name: k8s_manifest_audit
tools.description: Audit Kubernetes YAML/JSON manifests for missing resource limits, privileged securityContext, :latest tags, root containers, and probe readiness.

tools.name: k8s_resource_estimate
tools.description: Compute total Kubernetes cluster CPU (millicores), memory (MiB/GiB), and replica footprint from deployment specs or YAML requests/limits.

tools.name: terraform_plan_inspect
tools.description: Inspect Terraform `terraform show -json` plan output or HCL plan text to count create/update/destroy/replace actions and highlight destructive changes.

tools.name: hcl_format_and_validate
tools.description: Format Terraform/Packer HCL blocks with standard 2-space indentation, aligned = assignments, and balanced-brace syntax validation.

tools.name: nginx_config_audit
tools.description: Audit nginx.conf directives for TLS 1.0/1.1 weak protocols, missing server_tokens off, missing HSTS/security headers, and brace balance.

tools.name: apache_config_audit
tools.description: Audit Apache httpd / .htaccess virtual hosts for Indexes directory listing leaks, weak ServerSignature, TraceEnable On, and RewriteRule flags.

tools.name: github_actions_audit
tools.description: Parse GitHub Actions workflow YAML to extract jobs, triggers, matrix/needs DAG, unpinned third-party actions, and pull_request_target injection risks.

tools.name: github_actions_expression_eval
tools.description: Evaluate GitHub Actions ${{ ... }} conditional expressions against simulated github/env/inputs contexts with contains(), startsWith(), success(), and boolean logic.

tools.name: gitlab_ci_audit
tools.description: Parse .gitlab-ci.yml stages, job dependencies (needs), cache/artifact usage, and deprecated only/except directives into a pipeline summary.

tools.name: dotenv_audit_and_example
tools.description: Audit .env files for duplicate keys, unquoted spaces, weak placeholders, and high-entropy secrets, and generate a safe sanitized .env.example.

tools.name: cron_explain_and_schedule
tools.description: Validate a 5-field POSIX cron expression, translate it into human English, and compute its next N UTC firing timestamps.

tools.name: gitignore_generate
tools.description: Generate a deduplicated .gitignore file tailored for stacks like node, python, rust, go, c++, embedded, docker, and vscode/macos.

tools.name: bash_script_lint
tools.description: Static-analyze POSIX/Bash shell scripts for missing set -euo pipefail, unquoted variable expansions, backticks, and unsafe rm -rf targets.
